definitions.explanation: A water sport in which a person rides ocean waves while standing on a surfboard.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{毎週|まいしゅう}サーフィンに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go surfing every week in summer.

examples.japanese: サーフィンを{始|はじ}めたいけど{難|むずか}しそう。
examples.english: I want to start surfing but it looks difficult.

examples.japanese: {湘南|しょうなん}はサーフィンで{有名|ゆうめい}だ。

notes:
サーフィン is borrowed from English 'surfing' and refers to the water sport.

RELATED TERMS:
- サーファー: surfer
- サーフボード: surfboard
- ウェットスーツ: wetsuit
- {波|なみ}: wave
- {波乗|なみの}り: wave riding (native Japanese term)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- サーフィンをする: to surf
- サーフィンに{行|い}く: to go surfing
- {波|なみ}に{乗|の}る: to ride a wave
- {波|なみ}が{高|たか}い: waves are high

POPULAR SPOTS IN JAPAN:
- {湘南|しょうなん} (Shonan, Kanagawa)
- {千葉|ちば} (Chiba)
- {宮崎|みやざき} (Miyazaki)

USAGE:
ネットサーフィン (net surfing / internet browsing) uses the same word metaphorically.
